description: Partial warning-only checks for the pinned Segment IQM sender on /open?pid=segment. Query pixel completeness, source HTTP operations, JSON MIME and the POST object/data envelope are checked. DELETE payloads and custom data remain open. This does not contract /api/v1/iqm, /video or other IQM integrations.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: The Segment configuration declares a pixel_id setting and appends it to the query. This is sender completeness advice. Identifier grammar, blank-slot acceptance and account validity remain unestablished.
params.fix_hint: Compare with the Pixel ID configured in the Segment IQM destination; preserve the original provisioned value.

params.name: method
params.description: The pinned postEvent action uses POST and the deletion hook uses DELETE. Other methods differ from this sender profile; receiver acceptance is not asserted.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Both pinned operations declare application/json. This checks source transport consistency, not a universal receiver media-type rule.

params.name: query.pixel_id
params.description: The source places pixel_id in the URL query. A body or form field cannot satisfy that emitted query slot. Values and duplicate arbitration stay open.

params.name: body
params.description: The postEvent sender serializes its mapped payload object, including {} when no optional data is mapped. DELETE payload shape is not constrained.

params.name: body.data
params.description: The postEvent action declares optional object data. Omission and {} are native alternatives. Nested keys and values remain open. Mapped null/empty values can be removed by the framework before serialization; no receiver null policy is claimed.
